thesis: The episode introduces Brian Bares, founder of BCM, a $5 billion long-only boutique that employs independent qualitative research on growing companies to build highly concentrated portfolios. The conversation covers his early life investing lessons, bootstrapping an asset management business, and finding product-market fit, before turning to his investment approach, research process, position sizing, and the evolution of BCM from a microcap strategy to three strategies across market capitalizations.
